author: blekek.k
title: Looking for illustrators for trading card project
content:
Hi warga threads!

We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project

Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out.

We're looking for artists that draws
- Anime / manga style illustrations
- Cartoon / semi-cartoon illustration
- Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork
- Semi-realistic illustrations
- and any other art styles

Comment if you're interested or DM me directly!

author: Kat
title: Looking for a human artist for paid illustration work
content:
Looking for a human artist for some small, paid illustration work.

NO AI ART. No AI tools. I want to pay an actual artist for actual art.

I’m writing a series of short stories, and as I finish each one, I’m planning to release them digitally for free. Eventually, they’ll all be compiled into a physical book, so I don’t need full cover designs for every individual story.
